about: Linear mean albedo of the near ground library textures (8 px mip of each draft_* KTX2, sRGB-decoded), measured 2026-11-03 from generation 2e6515f4 tiles. The far ground pigment must equal the near material's distant colour. `near` is keyed by the material key without its draft_ prefix; the longest contained key wins. `legacy` translates the pigments of scenery derivatives built before this table (old fixed palette, unmatched keys white); remove it once the scenery cache has been rebuilt with tools/remote-drafts/scenery.mjs from this commit.
